messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED: High error rate and latency on prompt-routing -> new-edge-endpoint (canary). Pager triggered for @jamie_oncall. Root TS: 1768888888

jamie_oncall: I’m looking. Seeing 5xx spikes and tail latency on canary traffic. Metrics dashboard shows request error rate ~12% and p99 latency 3.2s (baseline 0.6s).

mike_sre: I’m on infra. Any recent kernel/quant changes on the canary?

leo_runtime: Deployed prompt-edge v2.3.1 to canary 15m ago. It has a new KV cache change for prefix pruning. Logs show repeated KV cache evictions.

anya_prod: Customers on canary group are small subset (internal + partner). We should flip the feature toggle if it's impacting external partners. Zoe, can you check any CS tickets?

zoe_cs: Received 2 partner reports complaining about slow responses and truncated outputs. CS has asked for immediate mitigation. I’ll open a bridge for affected partners.

jamie_oncall: Agreed — executing emergency feature toggle OFF for new-endpoint routing. @deploy-bot, flip rollout-gate prompt-edge-route to off for all traffic.

deploy-bot: Executing toggle change: rollout-gate.prompt-edge-route -> OFF
Change ID: cbf-20260402-11
Scope: canary + staged traffic
Status: started

leo_runtime: Seeing traffic shift away from the new endpoint. Error rate on canary dropping in the dashboard. P95/P99 trending down.

mike_sre: Quick note: logs during the surge show this repeated stacktrace — might help root cause:```
E0402 11:09:12.345 main.cpp:482] kvcache prune failed: invalid shard mapping (0x7f)
E0402 11:09:12.346 runtime.cpp:127] fallback path triggered: auth retry
```
Doesn’t look like a pure infra OOM. Could be incompatible kernel selection after quantization changes.

leo_runtime: Confirming — v2.3.1 selected a new fused attention kernel for long contexts; fallback path seems to blow up under interleaved prefix cache eviction patterns. We’ll roll back that kernel selection in a follow-up patch.

jamie_oncall: Toggle OFF completed. Monitoring shows customer-facing errors gone for partners. Assigning to @leo_runtime and @mike_sre for remediation and RCA.

anya_prod: I’ll notify affected partners that we rolled back the route and are investigating root cause. Zoe, can you coordinate CS messaging?

zoe_cs: On it. Drafting an update: short, apologetic, impact summary, and ETA for next update in 2 hours.

mike_sre: For the incident record: severity P1 (customer impact), mitigation: emergency toggle OFF, timeframe: 11:08–11:22 UTC. Please capture VM/container IDs if needed.

leo_runtime: Next steps for runtime: revert fused-attn kernel auto-select for prompt-edge v2.3.1, add a guard for kvcache prune under interleaved requests, and add a canary perf check for KV eviction patterns.

jamie_oncall: Handoff — I have to step out in 30m. @mike_sre please take lead on monitoring until morning oncall. Leave action items in the incident tracker.

mike_sre: Acknowledged. I’ll keep alerts muted for noisy signals, keep page if error >3% for 5m.

leo_runtime: Patching internal canary now to force kernel selection back to v1 path (non-fused). Will run a small synthetic load:```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.internal/prompt -d '{"prompt":"x"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer test' --parallel 50
```
I'll report results in 10m.

jamie_oncall: Thanks. Also add a follow-up to run the new perf test matrix in CI to catch this pattern.

zoe_cs: Partners notified. One asked for timeline and rollback confirmation — I shared that feature route was flipped off and engineering is tracking remediation.

deploy-bot: Rollout-gate.prompt-edge-route -> OFF completed at 1768888930

jamie_oncall: Confirmed: metrics show steady state. Closing immediate mitigation. Assigning RCA to leo_runtime with assistance from mike_sre. Will create postmortem doc and CS template.

leo_runtime: Will start RCA now, ETA preliminary notes in 4 hours.

mike_sre: I’ll remain on watch for the next 2 hours, then hand to morning oncall. Please post any logs to the incident thread.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: emergency mitigation applied. Status: mitigated (toggle off). Severity downgraded to P2 for RCA tracking. Close when postmortem uploaded.

jamie_oncall: Thanks everyone :heart: — good catch and quick mitigation.

leo_runtime: Follow-ups: (1) Add kernel compatibility test to canary gating, (2) telemetry for KV prune failure pattern, (3) rollback playbook update to include toggle command and confirm steps. I’ll author the tasks.

zoe_cs: CS follow-up planned for tomorrow to confirm partner health and closure.

mike_sre: Leaving notes in pagerduty and incident tracker. Handoff complete at 1768889055

jamie_oncall: Closing thread; please link postmortem here once ready.
